active_incident_id.title: Active Incident Id

dismissal.description: The alert's timed dismissal (REV-49); null when none is stored.

until.title: Until
until.description: UTC end of the dismissal; it stops suppressing the alert then.

state.title: State
state.description: Expired once the end has passed but before a write recorded that it ended.

assignee_display_name.title: Assignee Display Name
assignee_display_name.description: Stored directory name of assignee_id; null when unassigned.

operator_display_name.title: Operator Display Name

dismissed_until.title: Dismissed Until

key.title: Key

label.title: Label

total.title: Total
total.description: Exact alerts in the group as a decimal string; null when unavailable.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Exact alerts per severity in the group; null when unavailable.

status.title: Status
status.description: Exact alerts per visible status, for severity groups only; null otherwise.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Continues this group's rows through the feed's group paging.

DismissalValue.title: DismissalValue
DismissalValue.description: A timed dismissal (REV-49): exactly one of an end instant or a duration.

HtmlPanel.title: HtmlPanel
HtmlPanel.description:
A panel showing HTML; it references no preset (REV-57).

Validation bounds only the raw size. Callers sanitize with ``sanitize_panels``
after authorizing the request, so unauthenticated bodies are never parsed.

ImagePanel.title: ImagePanel
ImagePanel.description: A panel showing an uploaded image or an https image address (REV-62).

assignee_display_name.title: Assignee Display Name
assignee_display_name.description: Stored directory name of assignee_id; null when unassigned.

origin_rule_id.title: Origin Rule Id
origin_rule_id.description: Originating correlation rule of a correlation-created incident; else null.

origin_rule_name.title: Origin Rule Name
origin_rule_name.description: Current name of the originating rule; null when deleted or unknown.

total_linked.title: Total Linked
total_linked.description: Current linked alert references, each counted once, including unavailable ones.

suppressed.title: Suppressed
suppressed.description: Retained linked alerts suppressed by maintenance or dismissal now; null in a list row whose maintenance proof is not yet current (REV-56).

unavailable.title: Unavailable
unavailable.description: Current linked references whose alert is no longer retained.

unavailable.title: Unavailable
unavailable.description: Sections that could not be read in time.

Panel.title: Panel
Panel.description: A preset count panel; a panel without ``type`` is one (REV-57).

PanelLink.title: PanelLink
PanelLink.description: A panel's link button: an http(s) address and optional button text (REV-66).

assignee.description: Null when assignment history is unavailable.

covered_from.title: Covered From
covered_from.description: Start of the reported range after the 90-day retention clamp.

retention_from.title: Retention From
retention_from.description: Earliest instant whose history is guaranteed to be retained.

name.title: Name
name.description: Null for a deleted rule whose history is no longer retained.

first_response.description: Null when assignment history is unavailable.

ServiceNowPanel.title: ServiceNowPanel
ServiceNowPanel.description:
A panel showing a team's ServiceNow ticket count (REV-65).

The API server asks the deployment's ticket counting service for the count of
``team``'s tickets in ``ticket_state`` found by ``detection``. It references no
preset and is never part of a count batch; ``thresholds`` color the count like
a count panel's.

TablePanel.title: TablePanel
TablePanel.description:
A panel listing its preset's latest alerts, newest first (REV-63).

It references a preset like a count panel and shows ``rows`` alerts in the
preset's saved columns; it has no thresholds and is never counted.

host.title: Host
host.description: The service's scheme, host and port; never its path or query.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: The last failure's kind, such as timeout.

status.title: Status
status.description: count: the service gave a count; not_found: it doesn't know the team; no_count: it answered without a usable count; unavailable: it timed out, failed or gave no valid JSON; not_configured: no service is configured.

count.title: Count
count.description: The ticket count as a decimal string when status is count; else null.

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When this answer was fetched (answers are cached for up to 30 s); null when not configured or when no call slot was free.

last_count.title: Last Count
last_count.description: The last count for this query in the past hour, as a decimal string; null when none.

results.title: Results
results.description: One result per query, in request order.

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: Whether this deployment has a ticket counting service.

elapsed_ms.title: Elapsed Ms
elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds the test took, as a decimal string.

TicketCountTestRequest.title: TicketCountTestRequest
TicketCountTestRequest.description: An empty JSON object; product POST bodies are always JSON.
